P.F. 52095/B.4.c.        B.13. (Mrs. Brander)

As requested by telephone this morning I am to-day writing direct to Major Whetmore and send you herewith for Colonel Hinchley-Cooke's information a copy of my letter.

28.3.41.

P. Beckingham
